title: Security Deposit Account: Correction Credits on Disputed Unreturned-Fob Lines
content:
**Rule.** An unreturned-fob line under a dispute accepted because its fob charge was misapplied is not withdrawn: it stays on the statement at its corrected fob charge, and the excess of the fob charge over the corrected fob charge is credited against the balance owed by one dispute credit posted against the disputed fob line.

This rule governs the final account statement of a Security Deposit Account. It applies when a dispute recorded against an unreturned-fob line has been accepted because the fob charge was misapplied. The credit is due for as long as that fob line has no dispute credit posted against it.

| Before the credit | After the credit |
|---|---|
| The unreturned-fob line stands at the amount first itemized | The line stands at its corrected fob charge |
| The balance owed includes the excess | One dispute credit posted against the fob line lowers the balance owed by the excess |

## Posting the credit: `post_fob_count_credit_b88884f4`

**What the tool does.** It posts one dispute credit on a Security Deposit Account that lowers the account's balance owed, on account of a disputed unreturned-fob line that was recounted. One call records one new dispute-credit line on the account's final account statement. The line is tied to the single itemized unreturned-fob line named as its source and is dated the day of posting. The amount credited reduces what the former resident still owes, and nothing else on the account changes. The credit line is visible at once in the account's transactions.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `post_fob_count_credit_b88884f4`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_account_id` | Reference number of the Security Deposit Account that receives the credit, as returned by the deposit account lookup for this resident | Id |
| `source_transaction_id` | Reference number of the itemized unreturned-fob line the credit is posted against, as returned by the deposit transaction lookup for this account | Id |
| `amount` | The credit amount in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A one-line text receipt beginning "Dispute credit posted". It gives, in order: the new credit line's reference number, the deposit account reference number, the source fob line reference number, the amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places, and the posting date in YYYY-MM-DD form. The receipt means the credit was recorded.
